Title: TC-07.1 [AC-07.1] Front Desk can't read or edit DOB and Payment Notes on forms

Step Action: Precondition check: Synthetic Birthday and Payment Notes set by admin; column security enabled; Lakeview Supervisors profile = supervisor only.
Sign in as Front Desk test user (user1); open contact Claudia Mazzanti, Details tab.
Step Expected: Birthday shows a lock; no value visible; not editable.

Step Action: Open the test case with synthetic Payment Notes.
Step Expected: Payment Notes shows a lock and ******; not editable.

Title: TC-07.2 [AC-07.2] Front Desk views and exports don't show secured values

Step Action: As Front Desk test user (user1), open a Contacts view and add the Birthday column.
Export the view to Excel and open the file.
Step Expected: Birthday column empty or masked for every row.

Title: TC-07.3 [AC-07.3] Web API hides secured columns from Front Desk

Step Action: In Front Desk test user (user1)'s signed-in browser, GET /api/data/v9.2/contacts?$select=fullname,birthdate&$filter=fullname eq 'Claudia Mazzanti'.
Send a PATCH setting birthdate (Web API client, as Front Desk).

Title: TC-07.4 [AC-07.4] Supervisor can read and update secured columns (form and API)

Step Action: As Supervisor test user (user2), open Claudia Mazzanti and the test case.
Step Expected: Birthday and Payment Notes values visible (key icon).

Step Action: Update Payment Notes to a new synthetic value; Save.
Run the two GET requests from TC-07.3 in the Supervisor's session.
Step Expected: birthdate and lkv_paymentnotes return the values.

Title: TC-07.5 [AC-07.5] Minimal user can't open cases or contacts

Step Action: Sign in as minimal test user (user3, Basic User only); open Copilot Service workspace.
Step Expected: No access to the app, or no case records visible.

Step Action: Open a case or contact by URL.
